tira_sub: Don Quixote on a different adventure.
seo_titulo: De la extraña aventura de Don Quijote: Cervantes, from Cuba
seo_desc: Don Quixote and Sancho land in 1990s Havana: the story that won Reescribir El Quijote en Cuba in 2005, published by Cubaliteraria in 2021. Free download.

catalogo.glosa: Of the Strange Adventure of Don Quixote in Distant Lands
catalogo.premio: First prize, Reescribir El Quijote en Cuba, 2005
catalogo.sinopsis: Swept up by a gale at the windmills of chapter eight, Don Quixote and Sancho Panza land in a Caribbean capital in the 1990s, where a young poet takes them in. The jury that awarded it included Leonardo Padura. Free to read in Spanish.
